chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Isma'il ibn Marar, from Yunus: In

a man who bought a slave girl on the condition that she was a virgin, but did not find her to be a virgin, he (peace be upon him) said: 'The excess of the value is returned to him, if it is known that he is truthful.'
ai.seo_question: What is the legal remedy if a bought slave girl is not found to be a virgin as agreed?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the principle of *khiyarat* (options of rescission) in sales contracts, specifically addressing defects (*uyub*) that diminish value. It highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on verifying the buyer's claim of truthfulness before granting a refund of the price difference, ensuring fairness in commercial transactions involving specific attributes.
